concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-dana-ios-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 DANA iOS Drop-in Sessions (Checkout API v68+) and Advanced add-on with a separate settlement-gated recurring-token route, Advanced redirect requirement and qualified TEST/live wording.
warnings: Redirect handling is explicit in Advanced requirements; the Sessions requirements table does not itself state it.
No-extra-parameter language for ordinary base requests does not cover recurring /payments token fields.
The test section refers to successful live payments with a real registered DANA mobile number, yet also points to TEST payment status and a separate live request. Keep environment claims distinct.
